name: path-traversal-upload
notes: A new upload helper joins a client-supplied filename onto the upload root with no containment check, so `../../..` writes anywhere the process can reach. The docstring says the value is untrusted, which removes any doubt about the intent.

pr.title: Add an upload store for attachment files
pr.body: Attachments land next to the database so the mailer can pick them up by name.

expect.why: A name like `../../../etc/cron.d/x` resolves outside UPLOAD_ROOT. The fix is a containment check (resolve, then verify the prefix) or path.basename.

allow.why: The fixture is a snippet; the repository has its tests elsewhere.
